notes.title: Party Pumper hits steam Early access!
notes.notes:
“After a long way of bringing this bold concept to life, we are extremely excited to deliver VR players this truly one-of-a-kind experience. Party Pumper is our vision of todays true VR-gaming – vibrant, groovy and fun!”
Alexey Glebov, Producer

Born in the vibrations of music, Party Pumper is a game about parties and for parties!
Player's goal is to entertain the audience with the help of rhythm from mixes of music samples. Combine them with dance movements and fun party gadgets action to interact with partygoers crowd from the stage to Pump better!

The main tool is an innovative DJ panel with a rich arsenal of bass, melodies, drums, chords and other beats that forms a great foundation to create unique track on a fly.

Party Pumper is now available in Steam Early Access and HTC Viveport store. Currently supporting Rift, Rift S, Vive, Valve Index and WMR we plan to publish our game also in Oculus Store soon. After initial release on Oculus we are going to create full version of our game for Playstation VR.
